summary: Catron County tower on John Kerr Peak, Gila NF; FFLA lists it gone, but a 2019 trip report found braces, steps and a shed foundation on the summit.

facts.status_note: FFLA lists the tower as gone; a 2019 trip report describes four braces and steps still on the summit

access.note: Old four-wheel-drive road to the summit; 2019 report calls it minimally signed and needing high clearance; no closure found in the sources read

visit.trail_note: Old four-wheel-drive road to the summit; Continental Divide Trail lies east of the 2017 fire

events.note: Kerr Fire, lightning-caused, 30 acres on John Kerr Peak, starting May 1, 2017; sources do not tie it to the lookout

corrections.why: Vocabulary 'ruins' means footings or remains only; a 2019 trip report describes four braces, steps and a shed foundation still on the summit

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLA lists the tower as gone, while a 2019 trip report describes braces and steps still on the summit. The story reports both and facts.status is set to ruins pending an editor's call.

notes_for_editor: No build date, staffing or end date appears in any source read, so the story has no built or staffing paragraph. Remains come from one personal 2019 trip report, not a survey; the editor should weigh that before settling status (gone vs ruins). The 2017 Kerr Fire burned on the peak per NM Fire Info, but no source ties it to the lookout structure. Access level public is inferred from an open old road and no closure notice in the sources read.
